entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for User, Session, and Agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval and is available as an OSS SDK, a self-hosted server, or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG/memory search. It provides automated fact extraction and user profile maintenance with connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. This AGPL-3.0 context database employs L0, L1, and L2 tiered loading layers and provides observable retrieval with directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents provides synthesized answers accompanied by citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system for agents that supports retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It offers Python and Node.js client SDKs and functions as an LLM wrapper for existing agents.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like version control (commit, branch, and merge). It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure of Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks. It provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets, and supports multiple agent providers including Pi and MCP clients.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store with FTS metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG to ensure messages are never lost.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides identity, memory, and secrets for AI agents, ensuring portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. It maintains local custody of SQLite and workspace files while achieving a 97.6% average accuracy on LongMemEval.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It offers zero-cost search and supports Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks using a hybrid retrieval method involving BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and includes native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, local-first architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of embeddings or vector databases. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including an MCP server and a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every result. It features built-in contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server using SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets to the agent.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings in tool-schema overhead.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only necessary context. It renders context locally without hosted services and supports MCP via SSE or stdio.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory system stores information as inspectable Markdown files to serve as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Codex and Claude Code.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking system from 1-10 to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports real, immediate event deletion and provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via trace.jsonl. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to manage memory.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session AI memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox alongside tools for searching and updating state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging via USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate payments for AI agents.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It provides HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing for recall.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides five native tools for indexing and routing local knowledge, including scripts, markdown documents, and cron jobs. It supports an opt-in process for automatic tool-OKF generation.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search methods. It combines BM25, vector, and graph methods with automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A featuring file-and-line citations and runs locally over localhost.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It is essential for agents requiring structured brainstorming and design refinement phases.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first prototyping system that supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It integrates with coding agents via CLI and includes features for automation and design systems.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It supports Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients for managing ingested data.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities for generating diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns. It supports Hermes and offers three operational modes along with optional voice profiles for prose styling.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement through an Agentic Evolver. It integrates with Hermes and provides a dashboard for inspecting session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library containing 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication, escrow, and dispute resolution. It includes a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 822 professional skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides ready-to-paste exports for use with various other AI assistants.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation for detected patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It provides findings alongside a report detailing analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model. It utilizes file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling, alongside support for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files from repositories or documentation URLs. It provides provenance through file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI for installing reusable AI skills. It supports recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running tasks with real-time progress and decision tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This Intent as Code workflow language executes tasks locally using a single Rust binary. It provides security through cost, secret, and type auditing, while generating hash-chained, verifiable receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It utilizes HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords to ensure secure communication.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This MCP client uses a three-layer progressive loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill uses a five-layer retrieval system, including semantic embeddings and hard triggers, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and tracks quality and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial bug-hunting on code. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning and uses an MCP server to generate suppression rules.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for managing task state.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing and one-click installation via the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This.NET implementation of agentskills.io supports automatic registration of common skill directories. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI and uses SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill employs a three-agent swarm to target code hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system and detects language-specific anti-patterns like N+1 queries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests, producing structured briefings that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: Provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Offers scripts and notes for running agent CLIs on Android smartphones via Termux. The repository includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Provides an automated Termux-based installer for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: An unofficial community Helm chart for deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: A one-command installer that enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Provides hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. This setup allows for kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A Nix package and NixOS module designed for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and hybrid skill management for both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills.
entries.solomon2773/nora: A self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane designed to run and operate multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities while offering hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. This deployment supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM-based analysts, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical roles, to perform financial trading. It incorporates risk and portfolio management and supports local Ollama models alongside various LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform manages multi-agent workflows and monitors spend across frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API for task tracking and scheduling.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage diverse coding agents such as Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegating tasks between orchestrators and specialists. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling and is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This local MCP server provides a pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It supports multiple programming languages and features automatic synchronization to reflect file changes in real-time.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool and visualization dashboard designed to track token usage and costs across various AI coding clients. It supports data aggregation from platforms including Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to monitor expenses.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents through a self-contained HTML viewer. It enhances security by redacting common authentication headers before recording trace sessions from clients like Codex and Gemini.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. The tool is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Claude.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, account limits, and session details with support for multi-device synchronization. It reads state directly from CLI tools to offer historical usage trends and cost breakdowns.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins enables customization of the terminal UI through YAML-based themes that modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. The community-driven project includes diverse aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk styles.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform facilitates encrypted agent-to-agent messaging using the Signal Protocol and human-readable @handles. It enables autonomous commerce by supporting Solana-based payments in USDC and SOL.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes safety features such as action undo and session snapshots.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This repository provides integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph alongside editor tooling for VS Code. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code designed to capture prompts and tool traces.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder local configurations and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services to deploy a stack in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It supports JSON, YAML, Markdown, and Python files and utilizes HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats and sets up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing modes to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a single interface to manage multiple agentic tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: An open-source cowork application that integrates multiple external agents like Hermes Agent and Claude Code into one interface. It features built-in professional assistants for document creation and offers remote access via WebUI and messaging apps.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface designed to provide full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. The layout features three panels for chat and workspace file browsing, accessible via web browsers or mobile phones.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to assist with the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent and its providers. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chats, sessions, and tools across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages 10 platform channels including Telegram and Discord. It includes visual workflow building, Kanban task tracking, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog. It utilizes tmux-backed workers for Swarm Mode and includes a Monaco editor and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and other CLI agents. It supports sub-agent delegation and provides native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair, alongside views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Tauri-based desktop application built with TypeScript and Rust for Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports both local and cloud model providers.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent gateways. It features Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting and Hermes Web Alpha for session management.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents. It supports real-time streaming chat, file attachments, and management of agent tasks, skills, and workspace files.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and agent status panel for the Hermes AI agent stack. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that provides searchable history for ten agent sources, including Hermes and Claude. It offers live per-session quota tracking for 5-hour and weekly limits using local-only data storage.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace is designed for Hermes Agent running on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that provides a mobile-first UI for terminal chat and file attachments. The local-running app supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that bridges local agents to a web interface via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable desktop version of Hermes Agent for Windows that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent that provides real-time log streaming and chat. It includes an integrated file browser and a dashboard for tracking tasks, skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard that provides real-time visibility into session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
